name: dev-conventions
description: Development conventions in three tiers: a PreToolUse hook blocks the violations that can be detected mechanically (pip in a uv project, npm in a bun project, hand-edited lockfiles), each gated on positive evidence from the project itself and overridable with DEV_CONVENTIONS_ALLOW=1; a SessionStart hook injects only what cannot be enforced; skills carry the full reference on demand.
